definitions.explanation: A ticket or voucher issued at a parking facility, typically taken upon entry and presented upon exit to calculate the parking fee. Also refers to discount parking vouchers given by shops or businesses to customers.

examples.japanese: {駐車券|ちゅうしゃけん}を{取|と}ってください。
{駐車券|ちゅうしゃけん}をなくしてしまった。
お{買|か}い{物|もの}{金額|きんがく}に{応|おう}じて{駐車券|ちゅうしゃけん}の{割引|わりびき}サービスがございます。
examples.english: We offer a parking voucher discount based on your purchase amount.

notes:
USAGE:
In Japan, most commercial parking lots issue a {駐車券|ちゅうしゃけん} upon entry. Many department stores and shopping centers validate (stamp or process) parking tickets to give customers free or discounted parking based on purchase amount.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駐車券|ちゅうしゃけん}を{取|と}る (to take a parking ticket)
- {駐車券|ちゅうしゃけん}の{認証|にんしょう} (parking validation)
- {駐車券|ちゅうしゃけん}をなくす (to lose one's parking ticket)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: parking lot — the facility itself
- {駐車違反|ちゅうしゃいはん}: parking violation — an illegal parking ticket from police
